Detailed Description

template<class OwnerType = void>
class SpawnEventBase< OwnerType >

An event class for use with a Spawn UGen.

You can use an OwnerType to reference another object when the UGen is constructed. Use SpawnEventBase<void> or SpawnEventBase<> if there's no owner.

See also:
Spawn , SpawnEventBase<void> <
Template Parameters:
OwnerType Optional owner type (defaults to void).
